name: Advisor
description: Experimental: reviews ongoing agent work on the session's own model and offers one short correction.

everyToolCalls.label: Review every N tool calls
everyToolCalls.help: Review after this many tool calls start in a conversation, including during a run and commands still running in the background. 0 turns this trigger off.

everyMinutes.label: Review every N minutes
everyMinutes.help: Review after this many minutes of accumulated agent run time in a conversation. 0 turns this trigger off.
